mentions.name: TXR Lisp compiler
mentions.description: The TXR Lisp compiler. Current work improves an optimization pass that identifies and eliminates wasteful VM register moves; the optimization is working and has many good hits in the code base, but does not yet handle certain cases.
mentions.problem: The register-move elimination optimization works but does not handle certain cases of wasteful VM register moves.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on the TXR Lisp compiler, improving a certain optimization that identifies and eliminates certain kinds of wasteful VM register moves. It works and has many good "hits" in the code base, but doesn't handle certain cases.

evidence.value: I'm working on the TXR Lisp compiler, improving a certain optimization that identifies and eliminates certain kinds of wasteful VM register moves. It works and has many good "hits" in the code base, but doesn't handle certain cases.
